## 1. issue: 
We were trying to set up a wallet for @ubiquity-os-simulant for the demo.   Each time, the response comment indicated that the wallet was set successfully.  However, when generating permits, it couldn't fetch the wallet:
```
	›› Updating result for user ubiquity-os-simulant
	›› {
	     "caller": "PermitGenerationModule.transform"
	   }
Failed to get wallet {
  userId: 198770750,
  error: {
    code: 'PGRST116',
    details: 'The result contains 0 rows',
    hint: null,
    message: 'JSON object requested, multiple (or no) rows returned'
  }
}
```
I checked the database and confirmed that there is no user record with ID `198770750`, meaning the wallet is not actually being set. I also reviewed the Cloudflare logs for the plugin but found nothing unusual.
## 2. issue:
While coding the demo, I changed my wallet to a random address because permits were not being generated for me (which turned out to be a separate issue with the EVM private key being all zeroes).
When I tried to change my wallet back to the original one, I got an error stating that the wallet was already used by another user.  I checked the database and found that my wallet was assigned to user ID `124931263` (@devtestubq).
I'm not sure how this happened.  Either someone manually modified the database and made a mistake, or the plugin did this when I changed my wallet. However, I doubt that someone manually changed the database, as this issue occurred today while coding the demo.
